$comment: MCP client configuration for GitLab Duo (IDE / Agentic Chat). Format follows the publicly documented MCP client server config (mcpServers block). The pipeline-logs server runs locally and serves the same tool contract the demo uses; the GitLab entry is the template to enable once the project lives on GitLab 19.4+.

gitlab-live.$comment: TEMPLATE — enable after importing to GitLab. The GitLab MCP server (19.4, public beta) exposes CI/CD tools (get_job, save_pipeline), MR tools, and repo tools (add_commit) to agents, with read tools defaulting to Always Allow and write tools to Always Ask.

pipeline-logs.description: Local demo server: exposes get_failed_job_log, mirroring the GitLab MCP server CI/CD tool contract used by the remediate-pipeline flow.
